raw_text: Satellite imagery comparison: Kakhovka Dam before and after. Sentinel-2 pass from 0100 UTC shows intact structure. Planet Labs imagery at 0330 UTC shows catastrophic breach in central section. Water discharge estimated at 5x normal flow rate. Downstream flood modeling suggests 80+ settlements at risk within 48 hours.
